modID.description: The unique identifier of the mod, put as template.

modName.description: The name of the mod, defaults to the folder name if empty.

modVersion.description: The version of the mod, just for show in the file, only used to keep tracks.

excludedFilesList.description: List of excluded files, put their extensions if you don't excluse a folder (folder is only available for custom stories, encounters and sound).

dependenciesList.description: List of mod dependencies (based on the modName).

bonusNodes.description: Additional nodes in case other mods would use configs, can be anything.
